name: Suleiman Odapu
title: Strategic Communications Professional, Public Relations Specialist & Event Moderator
bio:
SULEIMAN ODAPU

Suleiman Odapu is a strategic communications professional, public relations specialist and accomplished event moderator with over 15 years of experience in communication, stakeholder engagement and development programming.

He has moderated high-level engagements for the World Bank, academic events at the University of Ibadan, Bayero University Kano, Nasarawa State University Keffi and peer-learning and knowledge-sharing sessions under the NG-CARES Programme and the Community and Social Development Project (CSDP), both World Bank Assisted.

He has a gift for engaging audiences and inspiring speakers to facilitate insightful conversations that bring out compelling ideas, keep discussions focused and transform conversations into memorable experiences.

An alumnus of Bayero University Kano, Nasarawa State University Keffi, Nigeria and University of Suwon, South Korea, Suleiman is from Nasarawa State.
